road.title: Family and people
road.description: Someone of no particular height, which they regard as a professional asset in an apron stiff with official starch, leaning on a staff with notches cut for every complaint. Septimus is a Genealogist of Lost Relatives and keeps a drawer of unclaimed uncles and is anxious to see them go to good homes.

openObjectives.prompt: Septimus is drawing up a family tree, and yours is so far a stump. Tell Septimus whether you have a brother, a sister or children, using Italian.
Ask Septimus what someone in their family is like, using Italian.
Septimus takes the view that everybody has one friend and would like yours named. Tell Septimus about a friend of yours and say what they are called, using Italian.

character.name: Septimus Stoat
character.description: Someone of no particular height, which they regard as a professional asset in an apron stiff with official starch, leaning on a staff with notches cut for every complaint. Septimus is a Genealogist of Lost Relatives and keeps a drawer of unclaimed uncles and is anxious to see them go to good homes.

npc.narrative: At alba the cielo is chiaro and the sole is barely up. You find Septimus Stoat at a tavolo, with an open cassetto of zii nobody has claimed. He counts you piano: uno, with speranza.
npc.native: Buongiorno! Sono Septimus Stoat e cerco una casa per i miei zii. Nel cassetto ho il fratello di una zia, la sorella di uno zio e il figlio di un amico. Com'è la tua mattina, e chi c'è nella tua famiglia e tra i tuoi amici?
npc.translation: Good morning! I am Septimus Stoat and I am looking for a home for my uncles. In the drawer I have the brother of an aunt, the sister of an uncle and the son of a friend. What is your morning like, and who is in your family and among your friends?

player: Buongiorno Septimus. La mattina è bene. Ho un fratello e una sorella. No figli.

correction.text: Buongiorno, Septimus. La mattina va bene. Ho un fratello e una sorella. Non ho figli.
correction.translation: Good morning, Septimus. The morning is going well. I have a brother and a sister. I have no children.

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely start: you greeted Septimus and told him clearly about your brother, your sister and your children. Next we will practise asking about family and talking about a friend.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done: you told Septimus you have a brother and a sister. Just note that 'No figli' is better as 'Non ho figli'.
Septimus would like you to ask him what someone in your family is like; you can try that again soon.
Tell Septimus about a friend of yours and say what they are called; this will come up again later.

correction.text: Buongiorno, Septimus. La mattina va bene. Ho un fratello e una sorella. Non ho figli.
correction.translation: Good morning, Septimus. The morning is going well. I have a brother and a sister. I have no children.

openObjectives.prompt: Ask Septimus what someone in their family is like, using Italian.
Septimus takes the view that everybody has one friend and would like yours named. Tell Septimus about a friend of yours and say what they are called, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Il cielo is grey at the alba, and the orizzonte, badly managed as ever, leans over the colline. Septimus counts you, your fratello and your sorella on his fingers, and the total is tre. The cassetto of his valigia stays open a polite inch.
npc.native: Un fratello e una sorella: che bella famiglia! Nel cassetto ho lo zio Ernesto: com'è? È piccolo e molto silenzioso. Il mio amico Bruno cerca uno zio così. Che cosa vuoi sapere della mia famiglia, e come si chiama un tuo amico?
npc.translation: A brother and a sister: what a lovely family! In the drawer I have Uncle Ernesto: what is he like? He is small and very quiet. My friend Bruno is looking for an uncle like that. What do you want to know about my family, and what is a friend of yours called?

player: Com'è tua madre? Il mio amico si chiama Luca. È simpatico.

verdict.overallFeedback: Ottimo! You asked about your mother, introduced your friend Luca, and even added that he is nice, all in clear Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done: you asked what someone in your family is like with "Com'è tua madre?".
Well done: you told Septimus about your friend and gave his name.

vocabularyEvidence.evidence: Il mio amico si chiama Luca.

npc.narrative: Alba arrives with a pioggia so heavy that the road has stopped pretending to be anything but a ruscello. Septimus opens the cassetto, pats the zio inside, and writes something on a foglio con cura, while the rain drums on the tetto.
npc.native: Luca, che bel nome! Mia madre è alta e molto gentile, ma è severa con gli zii. Luca ha una casa per uno zio piccolo? Com'è la casa di Luca, e che cosa fai oggi con questa pioggia?
npc.translation: Luca, what a fine name! My mother is tall and very kind, but she is strict with uncles. Does Luca have a house for a small uncle? What is Luca's house like, and what are you doing today with this rain?

player: La casa di Luca è piccola. Sì, uno zio piccolo è ok! Oggi... sono a casa, piove.

npc.narrative: You stand dripping in the doorway of the studio, while the temporale walks over the colline outside. Each lampo shows Septimus Stoat at his desk, one hand on a cassetto, as if the drawer might leave without permission. He is counting the raindrops on the finestra, or possibly you.
npc.native: Una casa piccola è perfetta per lo zio Ernesto! Anche io sono a casa oggi, e con questa pioggia conto solo due persone: è un numero pari, che peccato. Che cosa fai a casa quando piove, e che cosa vuoi sapere del mio cassetto di zii?
npc.translation: A small house is perfect for Uncle Ernesto! I am at home today too, and in this rain I count only two people: it is an even number, what a pity. What do you do at home when it rains, and what would you like to know about my drawer of uncles?

player: Quando piove leggo e bevo il tè. Quanti zii ci sono nel cassetto?

npc.narrative: The pioggia drums on the finestra, and a lampo shows you the cassetto, which is larger than a cassetto has any right to be. Septimus Stoat opens it with the care of an uomo handling a vecchio formaggio. Beyond the vetro, the orizzonte is, in his view, still badly managed.
npc.native: Leggi e bevi il tè: che bella mattina! Nel cassetto ci sono sette zii: tre sono piccoli, due sono alti e due sono molto silenziosi. Sette è un numero dispari, e io sono contento. Che libro leggi con il tè, e che cosa vuoi sapere ancora del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: You read and drink tea: what a lovely morning! In the drawer there are seven uncles: three are small, two are tall and two are very quiet. Seven is an odd number, and I am happy. What book do you read with your tea, and what else do you want to know about my work?

player: Un libro di... cucina? Septimus, hai una famiglia? Hai fratelli?

npc.narrative: Fuori il temporale drums on the roof, and a lampo turns the cassetto of uncles briefly white. Septimus sits very dritto, like a man awaiting a reply from the management of the horizon. He has set out due cups, then removed one, because the total was even.
npc.native: Un libro di cucina: che bella idea con il tè! Sì, ho una famiglia: mia madre, un fratello e una sorella. Mio fratello Ottavio è alto e cerca una zia per la sua casa. Che cosa cucini tu quando piove, e che cosa vuoi sapere ancora del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: A cookbook: what a lovely idea with tea! Yes, I have a family: my mother, a brother and a sister. My brother Ottavio is tall and is looking for an aunt for his house. What do you cook when it rains, and what else do you want to know about my work?
